taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: Host and forwarded-origin trust — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace Host/forwarded authority through trusted-proxy configuration into reset links, absolute URLs, routing or cache keys. Identify which intermediary strips/sets each field.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned local service and mailbox/sink. Compare the normal authority with one caller-selected value on the exact sensitive feature. Observe the generated link or routed protected response and whether a recipient actually relies on it.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A reflected host in a public debug message is not password-reset takeover. A proxy ignoring caller-supplied forwarded fields defeats that path; direct-origin access needs its own reachability evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use configured trusted public origins for sensitive links and bind forwarding trust to actual peers. Retest valid deployment/proxy routes, the original authority input and cache behavior if involved.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
